FAQ

QUESTIONS,
answered.

Anything else? Ask us directly or email Noah at hello@endcap.design.

How much does a website cost?

We quote each project after a short conversation, once we know the pages, content, and features it needs. Your proposal lists the deliverables, schedule, and price, and we agree on it before any work begins.

How long does a website take?

Most websites take two to four weeks once the content is ready. The proposal confirms the schedule.

What kinds of businesses do you work with?

Any business that needs a website that looks right and brings in inquiries: local businesses, restaurants, professional firms, contractors, real estate companies, and software products such as My Friendly Staff, CRE Redline, and DrivewAI.

Do you work with clients outside Orange County?

Yes. Our clients so far are in Southern California, and we can work remotely with businesses in other states by video call, phone, and email. Our city guides cover local market data and state website rules for major US metros.

Who will I work with?

Noah, the founder, handles your project directly, from the first conversation through design, review, and launch.

Can you write the content?

Yes. You can supply your own text, or we write it from a conversation and your existing material. Writing is scoped in the proposal.

Will a redesign hurt our search visibility?

A redesign includes moving your existing content and redirecting each old address to its new page, so search engines and bookmarks follow the change.

What happens after launch?

Website care covers hosting, software and security updates, and up to an hour of changes each month, with no long-term contract. Larger changes are quoted before we start.

Can our domain and email stay where they are?

Yes. We can point your domain at the new website without moving your email. If you would like us to manage the domain, we set it up with your business as the owner.
